verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an Admin REST API, the kcadm.sh Admin CLI, standard OIDC/SAML endpoints, and a server-side provider/theme extension model. None of these is an official client SDK: the APIs and CLI are adjacent interfaces, and the SPI is an extension mechanism. No first-party language libraries, client adapters, or admin-client packages are cited, so the applicable SDK axis has no supporting evidence.
